statement:
1.1 OVERVIEW of Inteacc payroll systems > 1.4 PROCESS SALARY - PAYSCALE employees > 1.4.1 Create Salary payscale

As a prerequisite for the first time, complete the configuration including the [Allowance rates](https://github.com/inteacc/erphelp/wiki/Payroll-management#allowance-rates). Once the allowance rates are defined, you don't need to define it every month as it is a common configuration, reused perpetually. 

When you create a salary, the initial screen above will appear unfiled except it will be filled in by the default company of the user. In order to proceed, select the company code and operating location. The system will automatically populate the start and end date of the payroll. This is possible since the Inteacc payroll system knows as the last date the salary was paid. Therefore, you will find the "Date from" and "Date to" fields are read-only.

4.0 SALARY ON-HOLD AND RELEASE > 4.1 Salary on-hold

The salary of an employee can be on hold in the event of the following:
* When the [employee separation](https://github.com/inteacc/erphelp/wiki/Organization-and-compensation#05-employee-separation) is initiated
* Manually putting the salary of any employee on hold
